the carcinogenic effect of 3′-M-DMAB is to produce two types of hepatocellular carcinoma, one of which is preceded by a hyperplastic nodule and the other by cholangiofibrotic areas.
the pleomorphic carcinomas arise in the cholangiofibrotic areas and the homogeneous carcinomas arise in hyperplastic nodular areas of the liver.
